summary: Creates an alias (macOS) or a shortcut (Windows)
description:
The .createAlias() function creates an alias (macOS) or a shortcut (Windows) to the folder with the specified aliasName name in the folder designated by the destinationFolder object.

Pass the name of the alias or shortcut to create in the aliasName parameter.

By default on macOS, the function creates a standard alias. You can also create a symbolic link by using the aliasType parameter. The following constants are available:

On Windows, a shortcut (.lnk file) is always created (the aliasType parameter is ignored).

Returned object

A 4D.File object with the isAlias property set to true.

params.name: destinationFolder
params.description: Destination folder for the alias or shortcut

params.name: aliasName
params.description: Name of the alias or shortcut
